_doc: Per-module options of the BYOC code pipeline (docs/BYOC.md 3.4, lane byoc-b3). qb2bas: the extra qb2bas.py arguments the committed <MOD>.bas.md was generated with (--tempbase = module header word 17 = compiler temp slot T0; --end = last reachable instruction where the code area has a data tail with no incoming edge, see <MOD>_header.md). bas2js: options of tools/byoc/bas2js.py (bas2js_defaults per back end, overridden per module) and where it writes. STARCOMM and STARTUP have hand-written pseudocode and a hand-written game/modules/startup.js, so they stop at the listing.

class._doc: tool_banner = generator name written into the file banners (the historical generator path, kept so the output stays byte-identical); base_class/runtime = what the module class extends and imports; runtime_doc = banner reference; screens_prefix = SCREENS_INDEX.md row prefix; tail 'devjump' = default export via <mod>/devjump.js + E.moduleInstance, 'inside' = ADDR/COMMON_VARS tables + inside/dev.js; locate_cursor = LOCATE args 3..5 -> this.cursor(); play_sync = PLAY not awaited; print_whole = a PRINT whose later item reads POS/CSRLIN is not split per item; fn_inline = DEF FN bodies as call-site templates instead of methods; alias_table = scalar -> [array, index] where the _why does not spell the element out.

flow._doc: info = the BLOADed INFO.BAS single table (base DS address, bytes) -> INFO[]; buffers = PUT/GET buffer names; two_d = first dimension of 2-D INFO arrays; text_fixes = [from, to] replacements in statement text before translation; inject_before = listing offset -> JS lines emitted before that statement; prelude = JS lines at the top of flow() (the module's DEF FNs).

strings._doc: STARCOMM and STARTUP run on the hand-written game/modules/startup.js; its game text is this generated table (pipeline.js stringTableJs).

variants._doc: per accepted version (manifest alt ver): data = [first address in the known release, offset to the same item in this version]; the string table is written under the known-release addresses. 1.2: the descriptors D2E6 and D2F0 sit 4 bytes higher, everything from D318 is unmoved.

bas2js._text_fixes_why: STARPORT.bas.md Manual corrections: at 4895, 4945, 4B04, 4CC2, 4D1E `word ptr [0xae70]` inside an imul expression is the integer variable NumIn% (0xAE70)

inject_before._10C3: Dev-jump hook: after the frame + port picture are drawn (010BA GOSUB SUB_1EFD returns), the dev page may redirect to a screen label (BUILD_PLAN §4 `?screen=<id>`). Not part of the original flow.
10C3: // dev hook (not in the original): ?screen=<id> redirects here, after frame + picture
9AAF: // Optional rule-book protection: skip the lock and challenge; use the original successful save path.
